name: presence-supabase
title: Supabase presence
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Supabase Realtime Presence adapter. Tracks a channel and maps sync, join, and leave onto the shared presence hooks.

meta.descriptionEs: Adaptador de Supabase Realtime Presence. No obliga a usar Liveblocks.

examples.title: Canal
examples.description: Ejemplo del estado de presencia. No abre un canal real.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Estado vacío, un usuario y cuarenta.

meta.usage:
const adapter = createSupabasePresence({
  supabase,
  room,
  presenceKey: userId,
  userId,
  info,
  initialPresence,
})

api.name: createSupabasePresence
api.description: channel(room, { config: { presence: { key } } }), track, and sync, join, and leave.

api.name: presenceKey / userId / info
api.description: Key for the channel and the local user payload.

docs: Enable Realtime and authorize the channel in the host project. Presence is not an authorization source. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite an existing Supabase client file; this item does not ship one.
